summary: Documentation and platform-cleanup landed for WebGPU (the web’s modern GPU API), and importantly Firefox now enables the `dual-source-blending` feature when the underlying hardware supports it. Dual-source blending lets a shader produce two separate outputs for blending in a single pass, enabling efficient advanced compositing and some high-quality blending effects that previously required workarounds. _Most users won’t notice a new setting_, but WebGPU apps and web content that use sophisticated blending can run faster or produce more correct results on supported GPUs.
